description: This header file declares functions and constants related to the ConfUi messaging protocol used in the cuttlefish project. It includes message types, sending and receiving functions for UI messages, and constants for session management.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a ConfUiMessage object to its string representation.

methods.name: RecvConfUiMsg
methods.description: Receives a confirmation UI message from the given file descriptor, returning a unique pointer to the message object.

methods.name: RecvConfUiMsg
methods.description: Receives a confirmation UI message associated with a session ID from the given file descriptor.

methods.name: SendAbortCmd
methods.description: Sends an abort command for a session via the given file descriptor.

methods.name: SendAck
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment message indicating success or failure for a session.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message with user selection, signed response, and message data for a session.

methods.name: SendStartCmd
methods.description: Sends a command to start a UI prompt with optional extra data and locale info.

methods.name: SendStopCmd
methods.description: Sends a command to stop a session.

methods.name: SendUserSelection
methods.description: Sends a user selection or cancel response for a session.

calls: SendAck(SharedFD, const std::string&, bool, const std::string&)
SendResponse(SharedFD, const std::string&, const UserResponse::type&, const std::vector<uint8_t>&, const std::vector<uint8_t>&)
SendStartCmd(SharedFD, const std::string&, const std::string&, const std::vector<uint8_t>&, const std::string&, const std::vector<teeui::UIOption>&)
